## Usage

```text
provenance diff [<old> [<new>]] [flags]
```

Compare the design history file at two git refs, entity by entity: what was added, removed or retyped, and for a changed entity, each field that changed, its text block by block and word by word. A value is compared as the schema types it, so reformatting a file, as fmt does, is no change; a moved file is no change either. Calculated fields and query fields' results are compared too, marked derived. Files that are not entities (`.component`, `schema/`, `rules/`, `templates/`, `assets/`, and the images entities show) are listed by path.

The refs are written as git's: with none, diff compares HEAD with the working tree; with one, that ref with the working tree; with two, the first with the second. old..new is old and new; old...new compares new with its merge base with old, which is what a pull request from new into old changes. A ref is a branch, tag, commit or any revision git resolves, such as HEAD~2. Each side is read from git's objects with its own schema and templates; nothing is checked out.

A side that has problems loading is compared as far as it loads, and its problems are listed first. `--scope` takes a query file or an entity file, as export's does, resolved at each side; an entity in either side's scope is compared.

Each `--output` names an output: text; html, one self-contained file showing each page the change touched as the site renders it at each side, marked block by block and word by word, with unchanged blocks folded; or a project's template templates/diff/&lt;name&gt;.tmpl, which replaces a built-in of the same name. name=file writes it to file, and with no `--output` the text goes to standard output. Nothing is written unless every output renders.

Exit codes: 2 for a ref that doesn't resolve, or any other error; otherwise 0, whether or not anything changed, unless `--exit-code` is given: then 1 when anything did.

## Flags

| Flag | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `--exit-code` | — | exit 1 when anything differs |
| `--output name` | — | output to write, as name or name=file: text, html or a template in templates/diff/; repeatable (default: text to standard output) |
| `--scope path` | — | path to a query file or entity file that limits the entities compared |
